intro.what: 0:34:19.4, the camera tilts up across Lake Ashi to reveal Biollante's rose form standing in the misty, glowing lake, one shot.

loop.what: 0:34:27, a slow low-angle tilt up Biollante's rose-form stalk and leaves to the closed red rose head, vines gently swaying, one continuous shot.

cut.what: 0:55:10, at night on the lake Godzilla's ray strikes a vine reaching out from Biollante and the vine bursts into smoke, one shot.

collect.what: 0:54:55, a run of two shots: a vine mouth sprays yellow sap into Godzilla's face, then Godzilla's head steams with it.

beast.what: 1:31:19, a run of two shots: extreme close-ups of the beast form's huge tooth-lined jaws, then the jaws opening on the red mouth, under lightning flashes.

won.what: 1:36:13, Biollante's beast form dissolves into a glowing pink cloud of spores that drift upward, one shot.

lost.what: 1:33:55, a run of two shots: Biollante's beast jaws close on Godzilla's head, then a close-up of the jaws clamped on him.

ablaze.what: A run of three shots: Godzilla's ray strikes Biollante's rose-form stalk in fiery orange bursts, smoke rolls over the lake, then his blue ray pours into the blazing rose, at 0:55:52.

burn.what: Close on Biollante's red rose head engulfed in roaring orange flames, the petals showing through the fire, at 0:56:02.

grab.what: At night on Lake Ashi Biollante's vines whip across and coil round the head of a roaring Godzilla, at 0:52:54.

cashout.what: A column of glittering golden spores rises from the burnt rose into the dark sky as the last flames flicker, at 0:56:43.

music.what: 1:42:08.682, Koichi Sugiyama's Super X2 march as reprised in the end credits (the same passage the earlier bed took at 0:43:05 under the Super X2 launch), orchestra only, no dialogue or effects.

cut.what: 1:09:00, a short, clean Godzilla roar during the Osaka attack, from its onset until it falls away at 1:09:02.

collect.what: 0:54:55, the wet burst of Biollante's sap spraying from a vine mouth into Godzilla's face and the first hiss of it burning, ending at a dip.

beast.what: 1:30:59.9, Biollante's beast-form roar as she rises at night, a falling screech into a deep growl.

won.what: 1:36:14.4, Biollante's soft, eerie dying cry, a falling wail that settles and fades as she turns to spores, over a quiet score.

lost.what: 1:32:49, Godzilla's pained roar as Biollante's vine mouths bite into his hands, ending as it falls away.

ablaze.what: Godzilla's ray fires with a sudden roaring hiss and blasts into Biollante across the lake, ending where the shot cuts away, at 0:55:27.6.

grab.what: Biollante's eerie whistling cry, a high glide that falls away, as a vine mouth lunges at Godzilla, at 1:31:48.6.

cashout.what: A soft, eerie wail from Biollante as her shape melts into the glowing pink spore cloud, fading to quiet, at 1:36:11.2.

beast.what: The film's own driving military battle march, steady brass chords over a pulsing orchestra, under the wireframe battle-plan display before the final battle, at 1:23:54.8.
